field.name: quota_mb
field.label: Storage for each person (MB)
field.help: Counts every stored file once, whatever its versions. 0 means no limit.

field.name: links_enabled
field.label: Allow sharing by link
field.help: Anyone in the organization who has a link can view what it points to.

field.name: link_days_max
field.label: Longest a link may work (days)
field.help: 0 means no limit; otherwise links must expire.

field.name: search_contents
field.label: Search the text inside files
field.help: Search finds words that are only in a file's text. Files already stored are not read again.
